messages:
Noah (sales): Kickoff for QuantaHealth POC. They need model onboarding for HIPAA data: embeddings + chat with strict audit logs. Can SE/infra confirm catalog fit and blockers?
Ava (SE): Summary: embeddings dim 1024 ok, prefer q4 variants to save cost. Chat model should support prefix KV caching. They also asked about model fine-tuning vs prompt-engineering.
Sam (infra): For HIPAA and audit logs, recommend Private deployment or Dedicated with strict logging. KMS customer-managed keys ok. For q4 embeddings, confirm if our quant kernels maintain vector fidelity.
Noah (sales): Procurement wants a monthly estimate for a mid-commit Dedicated plus one-time onboarding fee.
Rina (security): HIPAA means BAAs and audit logs retention policy. Also enforce no-cleartext storage of logs. We'll need compliance checklist completed.
Ava (SE): I'll run an embedding fidelity test (1k samples) and a KV perf bench for the chat. Will compare q4 vs fp16.
ops-bot: Created ticket #DEP-5012 - quantahealth-onboard.
Sam (infra): I'll prepare infra template and estimate. Quick ballpark: $18k/mo committed for Dedicated with HA and EU region compliance add-on. One-time onboarding ~ $6k.
Ava (SE): I'll post bench results as a tiny CSV and a short note on model/catalog recommendation.
